title: React to a click
summary: An event listener is a function that runs when an event happens.

Explain the example for react to a click

blocks.text: An event listener is a function that runs when an event happens. A click listener can change a page after a button is pressed.
The HTML examples are complete small page parts. Use this site's HTML Run button. Put the script after the elements it uses so those elements already exist.
Read the code step by step

items: `textContent` reads or replaces plain text inside an element. It does not interpret the supplied words as HTML.
`addEventListener` waits for the named event before calling the function you pass to it.
`querySelector` finds the first matching element. Check for a missing result when the element is optional.

blocks.text: Clicking the button puts Hello, reader! in the paragraph.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Pass a function to addEventListener. Do not call it immediately when you mean to wait for a click.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Change the reply to a greeting for your club.
